newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African rand dives to 4.60 against dollar.
newsitem.headline: S.African rand dives to 4.60 against dollar.

text.p: The South African fell to a new all-time low of 4.60 bid against the dollar on Friday after breaking through the previous low of 4.59 set on August 19.
Foreign exchange dealers said the rand was hit by heavy selling out of London and a weak bond market, depressed by comments from central bank governor Chris Stals and at a conference in Johannesburg.

Stals warned that already high South African interest rates might have to be hiked further if there was no slowdown in money supply growth, and cautioned the country's low reserves ruled out any early scrapping of exchange controls on residents.
